newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb wounds three in Algerian town - residents.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds three in Algerian town - residents.

text.p: A homemade bomb lightly wounded three people in the Algerian town of Blida on Monday, eyewitnesses said.
They told Reuters by telephone that the bomb went off in a car port in the centre of the town, which lies some 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers.
There was no official comment on the blast.
Last Thursday a bomb killed two people and wounded around 20 in an Algiers cinema.

Algerian officials have blamed Moslem fundamentalists seeking to overthrow the authorities for the violence, including bomb attacks, in which about 60,000 people have been killed in more than five years.
